challenge.method: Compare the 14.3 Evaluation sequence and the archived HoldAll, Evaluate and NHoldAll references. Check HoldAll defaults, direct Evaluate, an argument Sequence, an Unevaluated wrapper, an argument upvalue, parsing and the separately specified action of N.
challenge.results: HoldAll permits the wrapper, Sequence and upvalue operations by default. HoldAllComplete disables them in the documented standard sequence and bars the Evaluate override. The held head and the representation before evaluation need separate analysis, and NHoldAll describes the distinct N traversal. The selected statement neither defines parsing and formatting nor generalizes from evaluation to numeric approximation.
